user.title: Rootine
user.description: Care routines for plants. All fields are optional defaults for every plant.

data_description.rain_entity: Sensor with the daily rain total in mm. Needed for the rain mode.
data_description.rain_threshold: Rain since the last watering that counts as watered (default 5 mm). Each plant can have its own value.
data_description.weather_entity: Provides the forecast for frost and heat warnings (queried hourly).
data_description.outdoor_temp_entity: Outdoor temperature for plants without their own sensor. Only it can trigger heat warnings.
data_description.default_location: Default for new plants. Each plant can be changed later.

profile.title: Plant profile
profile.description: Everything is optional and can be changed later.{image}

water.title: Watering
water.description:
Care text: {care}

One line per period, e.g. `01.03.–31.10.: 6`. `Pause` or `ganzjährig: 7` also work.

data_description.mode: By schedule: fixed intervals. Schedule + rain: rain counts as watering. By sensor: the soil moisture sensor decides.
data_description.schedule_text: One line per period, e.g. 01.03.–31.10.: 6. Empty = no fixed schedule (with a sensor: no “at the latest”).
data_description.moisture_threshold: Watering is due when the evaluated moisture falls below this. The scale depends on your sensor.
data_description.moisture_method: The 24 h median smooths the daily swing (sun) and is almost always the best choice.
data_description.valve_counts_as_watering: Off for sensor plants: the sensor decides, the valve is only used for classification.
data_description.last_done: So the schedule knows where to start.

sensors.title: Sensors
sensors.description: All optional. Without a moisture sensor the plant follows its schedule.

data_description.moisture_entity: With a moisture sensor, mode “by sensor”, “too wet” and watering detection become available.
data_description.temperature_entity: For the cold protection warning. Heat is never derived from this sensor.
data_description.valve_entity: Rootine only reads the valve, it never switches it.

limits.title: Limits
limits.description: All optional. OpenPlantbook suggests {hint} (comfort range, not meant for frost protection).

data_description.temp_min: Below this “protection needed” is reported (e.g. 5 °C to bring the plant inside).
data_description.temp_max: Above this “protection needed” is reported, only from forecast or outdoor sensor.
data_description.moisture_max: If moisture stays this high for 48 hours, “too wet” is reported (waterlogging).
data_description.rain_threshold: Overrides the global rain threshold for this plant.
